lines.zh: 我踩过诡异菌，菌盖被我压弯。
lines.en: I step over warped fungus and bend its caps down.

lines.zh: 藤蔓从肩上垂下来，拖在地上。
lines.en: Vines hang from my shoulders and trail on the ground.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走，脚不沾地。
lines.en: I walk step by step without touching the ground.

lines.zh: 蓝绿色的林子在我身后合上。
lines.en: The blue-green forest closes behind me as I pass.

lines.zh: 我走过菌岩，留下浅浅的脚印。
lines.en: I cross the nylium and leave faint footprints.

lines.zh: 缠怨藤缠着我的腿，我不去解。
lines.en: Twisting vines wrap my legs, and I do not untangle them.

lines.zh: 我在菌光体之间穿行，避开光。
lines.en: I weave between shroomlights, keeping away from the glow.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声像水泡破开。
lines.en: My footsteps sound like bubbles breaking.

lines.zh: 我沿着诡异森林的边界走。
lines.en: I walk along the border of the warped forest.

lines.zh: 藤须扫过地面，沙沙响。
lines.en: My vine tendrils sweep the ground with a soft rustle.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，像个影子。
lines.en: I move slowly, the way a shadow does.

lines.zh: 我绕过岩浆湖，不碰热的东西。
lines.en: I skirt the lava lake and touch nothing hot.

lines.zh: 我站着，藤蔓在风里轻轻晃。
lines.en: I stand still, and the vines sway gently in the wind.

lines.zh: 蓝色孢子落在我肩上，我不拍。
lines.en: Blue spores settle on my shoulders, and I do not brush them off.

lines.zh: 我盯着菌岩上的一滴水。
lines.en: I stare at a single drop of water on the nylium.

lines.zh: 林子安静，只有菌在长。
lines.en: The forest is quiet; only the fungus is growing.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很亮，自己却看不见。
lines.en: My eyes are bright, though I cannot see my own glow.

lines.zh: 藤须缠住我的手腕，我没挣。
lines.en: A tendril wraps my wrist, and I do not pull free.

lines.zh: 我在听远处末影人的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the sound of distant endermen.

lines.zh: 菌光体亮着，我避开那圈光。
lines.en: A shroomlight glows, and I avoid its circle of light.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像株长错地方的藤。
lines.en: I stay motionless, a vine growing in the wrong place.

lines.zh: 藤叶间有虫子爬，我由它去。
lines.en: An insect crawls between my leaves, and I let it.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很轻，几乎没有。
lines.en: My breathing is faint, almost not there at all.

lines.zh: 我记得自己以前不是这个样子。
lines.en: I remember that I did not always look like this.

lines.zh: 蓝紫色的汁液从藤上滴下来。
lines.en: Blue-purple sap drips down from my vines.

lines.zh: 我在等一件值得转身的事。
lines.en: I am waiting for something worth turning around for.

lines.zh: 藤上的水珠落下来，我没躲。
lines.en: A drop falls from the vine. I don't dodge.

lines.zh: 蓝光一闪一闪，像在数我的心跳。
lines.en: The blue light pulses, as if counting my heartbeats.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，藤须跟着抬起来。
lines.en: I raise a hand, and the vine tendrils rise with it.

lines.zh: 菌岩那边传来脚步，我偏了偏头。
lines.en: Steps come from the fungus rock; I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 你把头转开，我就不会动。
lines.en: Look away, and I will not move.

lines.zh: 你直视我的眼睛，这很危险。
lines.en: You look straight into my eyes, and that is dangerous.

lines.zh: 你走过末地，鞋底还带着紫影。
lines.en: You have walked the End; purple dust clings to your soles.

lines.zh: 我歪头，藤蔓跟着晃。
lines.en: I tilt my head, and the vines sway with it.

lines.zh: 你手里的剪刀，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the shears in your hand.

lines.zh: 你在数我的藤，我数你的手指。
lines.en: You count my vines, and I count your fingers.

lines.zh: 你退后，我也没有前进。
lines.en: You step back, and I do not advance either.

lines.zh: 你的影子在菌岩上，很黑。
lines.en: Your shadow on the nylium is very dark.

lines.zh: 你又看我了，我记住了。
lines.en: You looked at me again, and I have noted it.

lines.zh: 你不说话，那我也不说。
lines.en: You say nothing, so I say nothing too.

lines.zh: 你的眼白里有我的倒影。
lines.en: My reflection sits in the whites of your eyes.

lines.zh: 我低下头，藤挡住了大半张脸。
lines.en: I lower my head, and vines hide most of my face.

lines.zh: 藤断了一截，汁液流下来。
lines.en: A length of vine snaps, and sap runs down.

lines.zh: 我闪开半步，还是被砍到了。
lines.en: I flicker half a step, but the blade still lands.

lines.zh: 这一下比普通末影人疼得多。
lines.en: That hurts far more than a plain enderman would feel.

lines.zh: 我的身体晃了晃，没有散。
lines.en: My body wavers, but it does not come apart.

lines.zh: 藤须缩回去，护住胸口。
lines.en: The tendrils pull back to guard my chest.

lines.zh: 你的剑带走了我一块皮。
lines.en: Your sword carried off a piece of my skin.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只是往后退。
lines.en: I do not cry out; I only step back.

lines.zh: 蓝血滴在菌岩上，很快就干了。
lines.en: Blue blood drips on the nylium and quickly dries.

lines.zh: 我又站稳了，比刚才更静。
lines.en: I steady myself again, quieter than before.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想回末地。
lines.en: That blow makes me want to return to the End.

lines.zh: 我不吃你递来的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat what you hold out to me.

lines.zh: 诡异菌？那本来就是我踩的地。
lines.en: Warped fungus? That is the ground I already walk on.

lines.zh: 你把蘑菇收好，我只要安静。
lines.en: Put the mushroom away; I only want quiet.

lines.zh: 食物对影子没有意义。
lines.en: Food means nothing to a shadow.

lines.zh: 我不是猪灵，金锭换不动我。
lines.en: I am no piglin; gold cannot buy me.

lines.zh: 你举着那朵菌，我倒退一步。
lines.en: You raise that fungus, and I take a step back.

lines.zh: 藤蔓渴了，可它不喝你的水。
lines.en: My vines are thirsty, but they will not drink your water.

lines.zh: 我闻不到香味，只闻到菌丝。
lines.en: I smell no food, only fungal threads.

lines.zh: 你放下东西，我才靠近一点。
lines.en: Set it down, and I might come a little closer.

lines.zh: 别用食物哄我，我连嘴都懒得张。
lines.en: Do not coax me with food; I will not even open my mouth.

lines.zh: 你穿过我的藤，藤断了两根。
lines.en: You push through my vines, and two of them snap.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你却像撞进冷水。
lines.en: We collide, and you feel like you hit cold water.

lines.zh: 我的身体太轻，撞不疼你。
lines.en: My body is too light to hurt you on impact.

lines.zh: 藤须挂住了你的剑鞘。
lines.en: My tendrils snag on your scabbard.

lines.zh: 你退开时，地上落了几片叶子。
lines.en: As you pull away, a few leaves fall to the ground.

lines.zh: 我闪了一下，还是慢半拍。
lines.en: I flicker away, but still half a beat late.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到我的手臂，凉的。
lines.en: Your shoulder meets my arm, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 我们挤在菌岩缝里，谁也过不去。
lines.en: We are stuck in a nylium crevice, neither able to pass.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的藤散了一半。
lines.en: That bump scattered half of my vines.

lines.zh: 我撞到你，孢子落了你一头。
lines.en: I bump you, and spores rain onto your head.

lines.zh: 末影人不需要这样的同伴。
lines.en: Endermen do not need that kind of company.

lines.zh: 我的藤是从别处缠上来的。
lines.en: My vines wound themselves around me from somewhere else.

lines.zh: 繁殖？我连自己是什么都说不清。
lines.en: Breed? I cannot even say what I am now.

lines.zh: 森林里只有菌，没有同类。
lines.en: There is only fungus in this forest, no kin.

lines.zh: 我记不得上一次靠近谁。
lines.en: I cannot remember the last time I stood near anyone.

lines.zh: 藤蔓替我抱住了自己。
lines.en: My vines hold me in place of arms.

lines.zh: 别问，影子不生孩子。
lines.en: Do not ask; shadows do not bear children.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢一个人站着。
lines.en: I would rather stand here alone.

lines.zh: 我的同伴都在末地，很远。
lines.en: My kind are all in the End, very far away.

lines.zh: 这身藤，让我不敢碰别人。
lines.en: This coat of vines keeps me from touching anyone.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块菌岩，又放下。
lines.en: I pick up a piece of nylium and set it down.

lines.zh: 地上有枚末影珍珠，碎了一半。
lines.en: An ender pearl lies on the ground, half shattered.

lines.zh: 我把断藤绕回肩上。
lines.en: I wind the broken vine back over my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，我没有碰。
lines.en: You dropped something, and I did not touch it.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片菌盖，盖住手臂。
lines.en: I pick up a fungus cap and cover my arm with it.

lines.zh: 剪刀落在我脚边，我踢开。
lines.en: The shears land by my feet, and I kick them away.

lines.zh: 我拾起自己的藤须，接不回去。
lines.en: I gather my severed tendrils, but they will not rejoin.

lines.zh: 那块紫水晶，照得我眼睛疼。
lines.en: That amethyst shard makes my eyes ache.

lines.zh: 我只捡能遮住身体的东西。
lines.en: I only pick up things that can cover my body.

lines.zh: 我把珍珠碎屑捏在手里，慢慢化掉。
lines.en: I hold the pearl dust until it slowly dissolves.

lines.zh: 你看了我太久，我转过身。
lines.en: You looked at me too long, so I turn around.

lines.zh: 有人踩断了我的藤，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone snapped my vine, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 那个方向有活物在动。
lines.en: Something living is moving in that direction.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，林子忽然安静。
lines.en: I raise my hand, and the forest falls silent.

lines.zh: 你的剪刀离我太近了。
lines.en: Your shears are far too close to me.

lines.zh: 你在我的菌岩上留了脚印。
lines.en: You left footprints on my nylium.

lines.zh: 我感觉到目光，像有虫在爬。
lines.en: I feel a gaze on me, like insects crawling.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近，带着铁和火。
lines.en: Something approaches, carrying iron and fire.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人盯着看。
lines.en: I do not like being stared at.

lines.zh: 目标就是刚才转头的那个人。
lines.en: The target is the one who just turned their head.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，隔着三棵菌。
lines.en: I follow you, three fungus stalks behind.

lines.zh: 你跑，我就出现在你前面。
lines.en: You run, and I appear in front of you.

lines.zh: 藤蔓拖在地上，声音跟着你。
lines.en: My vines drag on the ground, and the sound follows you.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，不急着到。
lines.en: I shift forward step by step, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我就停下。
lines.en: You look back, and I stop moving.

lines.zh: 我在菌光体的光外等你。
lines.en: I wait for you outside the shroomlight's glow.

lines.zh: 你拐进林子，我抄近路。
lines.en: You turn into the forest, and I take a shorter path.

lines.zh: 从菌岩那头起，我就没眨眼。
lines.en: I have not blinked since you crossed the nylium.

lines.zh: 你喘气的方向，我都听得见。
lines.en: I can hear which way you are gasping.

lines.zh: 这片林子没有出口，我知道。
lines.en: This forest has no exit, and I know it.

lines.zh: 我抬手，你被推得踉跄。
lines.en: I raise my hand, and you stagger backward.

lines.zh: 这一下没有声音，只有风。
lines.en: That strike makes no sound, only wind.

lines.zh: 你撞在菌岩上，孢子扬起来。
lines.en: You hit the nylium, and spores burst into the air.

lines.zh: 我的手指很长，够得到你。
lines.en: My fingers are long enough to reach you.

lines.zh: 你格挡了，可我的力气不止这些。
lines.en: You blocked it, but I have more strength than that.

lines.zh: 我一挥，藤须扫过你的脸。
lines.en: I sweep my arm, and tendrils rake across your face.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的第二下已经落下。
lines.en: You pull back, and my second blow already lands.

lines.zh: 这一击带着诡异菌的凉气。
lines.en: That blow carries the chill of warped fungus.

lines.zh: 你倒下时，我低头看你。
lines.en: When you fall, I look down at you.

lines.zh: 我打完就退进藤里。
lines.en: I strike, then withdraw into the vines.

lines.zh: 我从菌岩缝里立起来。
lines.en: I rise out of a crack in the nylium.

lines.zh: 藤蔓先长出来，然后是手。
lines.en: The vines grow first, then the hands.

lines.zh: 诡异森林多了一个影子。
lines.en: The warped forest has gained another shadow.

lines.zh: 蓝光照在我身上，我睁开眼。
lines.en: Blue light falls on me, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我是从一株缠怨藤里爬出来的。
lines.en: I crawled out of a twisting vines stalk.

lines.zh: 菌盖在我脚下慢慢合拢。
lines.en: The fungus caps slowly close beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 林子记得我，我也记得它。
lines.en: The forest remembers me, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，像一直没走。
lines.en: I stand here as if I never left.

lines.zh: 孢子落了一地，我抬头。
lines.en: Spores fall everywhere, and I look up.

lines.zh: 末地的风把我吹到了这里。
lines.en: The wind of the End blew me here.

lines.zh: 我又长回了这身藤。
lines.en: I have grown back into this coat of vines.

lines.zh: 有人在我的林子里点火。
lines.en: Someone is lighting fires in my forest.

lines.zh: 火苗顺着藤爬上来，我拍不掉。
lines.en: Flames climb my vines, and I cannot beat them out.

lines.zh: 我从菌岩上跌下去，藤垫了一下。
lines.en: I drop off the nylium, and my vines break the fall.

lines.zh: 水让藤变重，我沉了下去。
lines.en: Water makes my vines heavy, and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀飞我的藤，我在半空散开。
lines.en: The blast tears my vines away, and I scatter midair.

lines.zh: 箭穿过藤蔓，钉进我肩膀。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my vines and lodges in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 药水的光缠住我，像另一层藤。
lines.en: Potion light wraps me like another layer of vines.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这身藤会饿。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet these vines still grow hungry.

lines.zh: 雷照亮整片林子，我眼白了一下。
lines.en: Lightning lights the whole forest, and my eyes flash white.

lines.zh: 虚空和末地很像，但没有菌。
lines.en: The void resembles the End, but there is no fungus.
